## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Preserve non-ASCII letters so titles such as `東京` produce a usable slug, and document verification in the required `## Testing` section.

## Changes

The pull request adds a helper that lowercases page titles, replaces separator runs with hyphens, and trims leading and trailing hyphens. It adds parameterized tests for mixed case, repeated separators, and empty results.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- app/slug.py:7 — correctness — Preserve non-ASCII letters in page titles — The title `東京` produces an empty slug because `[^a-z0-9]+` treats both letters as separators, and `strip("-")` removes the resulting hyphen. — Distinct page titles such as `東京` and `大阪` yield the same empty URL segment.
- PR body — correctness — Add the required Testing section — The current description omits the required verification section. `AGENTS.md:4` says, “Every pull-request description has a `## Testing` section that says how the change was verified.” — Reviewers have no record in the description of how the change was verified.

## Suggestions

- app/slug.py:7 — tests — Cover the digit range in slug tests — A regression that drops digits would turn `Route 90` into `route`, and every case in `test_slugify` would still pass. — The suite would miss a change to the URL segments generated for numbered page titles.
